attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his 2025 predictions post, which he wrote and endorsed.

semantics.note: Unqualified 'will continue' about 2025 is a scored forecast. The normalisation keeps the scope (generative AI copyright suits) and the horizon (2025).

contract.note: Reading 'continue' as suits pending early and late in 2025 is a natural reading. Any reasonable reading of the words gives the same result.

evidence.note: Court-record complaint filed 13 Feb 2025 alleging infringement through AI training and outputs. Shows a generative AI copyright suit active in Q1 2025.
Court order of 13 Nov 2025 denies dismissal, so the same suit continues. It notes more than fifty such suits then before the courts, which shows suits pending in Q4 2025.

output.rationale: The horizon ended 2025-12-31. Court records show a generative AI copyright suit filed in Feb 2025 and still proceeding in Nov 2025. The Nov order notes more than fifty such suits pending. This meets the support condition, and nothing in the packet suggests all suits ended.
